title: Change or cancel a service centre booking
summary: You can change or cancel a service centre booking online if you need to complete an application.
intro:
If you need to change or cancel a booking you've made to complete an application at a service centre, you can do this online.

If you need to cancel a driver knowledge or driver testing booking, please visit View, change or cancel a driver or rider licence test instead.

Note: If you need to change your appointment type (for example, from a contractor licence application to an Owner-Builder Permit application), please cancel the appointment completely before booking a new one.
what_you_need: Your booking reference number (found in the confirmation email or text message)
Your last name, mobile number, or email address used when booking the appointment

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Change or cancel online' button.
Enter either your booking reference number, or the name and mobile number or email address you used to make your booking.

internal_links.text: View, change or cancel a driver or rider licence test

faqs.q: What should I do if I need to cancel a driver knowledge or driver testing booking?
faqs.a: Please visit View, change or cancel a driver or rider licence test instead.

faqs.q: What if I need to change my appointment type?
faqs.a: You must cancel the current appointment completely before booking a new one.

faqs.q: How do I change or cancel my booking online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Change or cancel online' button, enter your booking reference number or the name and contact details used to book, and follow the prompts.
